title: Calendar preview clipping fix + event tooltips in the digest
summary: The Calendar Preview widget's header row (title, gear, 'Open full calendar' button) and other non-grid content could get squeezed/clipped whenever the day-grid's flex:1 growth left too little room -- those now keep their natural size, and only the day-grid itself flexes.

Calendar events in the Today and This Week digest banners now show a rich hover tooltip (category, time, description) the same way class references already do elsewhere in the app, instead of only a plain browser title tooltip.
